caption: Piazza Vecchia, Bergamo Alta
composition: Contarini fountain and civic palace in the upper town · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is from the middle of the empty Piazza Vecchia on a grey morning, looking across at the civic heart of Bergamo Alta. The sculpted Contarini fountain stands in the left foreground, the tall civic tower rises at the center, and the arched loggia of the Palazzo della Ragione runs rightward beneath its crenellated crown. The modelled 23 September 2026, 07:28 sky is overcast and silvery, flattening the light so the pale stone of the square reads almost monochrome.
